faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes S400d use?
faqLeft.a: The S400d uses the OM656 — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel — across both the W222 (2017–2020) and W223 (2020–present) generations. The engine family is the same, but the specific component and electronic specifications differ between the two chassis.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes S400d engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,800. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my S400d?
faqLeft.a: All S400d models use the OM656. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact generation and build specification before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM656 S400d engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, bearings and gaskets as standard on every OM656 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used S400d engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my S400d if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an S400d engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most S400d owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
